newsitem.title: POLAND: Peugeot-Citroen Polish unit sells PLN 21 mln CPs.
newsitem.headline: Peugeot-Citroen Polish unit sells PLN 21 mln CPs.

text.p: The Polish unit of Peugeot Citroen on Wednesday sold 21 million zlotys worth of commercial paper from its two-year 30 million zloty programme, one of the programme's dealers said.
Slawomir Komonski of Societe Generale told Reuters that the bank sold 10 million zlotys worth of two-month paper and 11 million of one-month paper with a value date of March 6.
"Prices and yields of the commercial papers are in line with the market, comparable to similar maturity T-bills," Komonski said. @
He added that the Peugeot Citroen CP programme, which ended this year, was likely to be renewed and boosted to 60 million zlotys of outstanding debt.
The Polish unit of ING is the other dealer of the programme.
